title: This Is It
desc: dark minor-key funk pop, tight drums, slap bass, synth stabs, tense female vocal
lyrics:
[Verse]
Static on the line at the edge of the night
Every window's dark but one burning light
I hear the footsteps that I swore were gone
Playing back the same old song

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't you tell me it's over, don't you lie to my face
I can feel you in the shadows, I can see you in this place

[Chorus]
This is it, this is it
Every secret's coming out
This is it, this is it
No more shadows, no more doubt

[Verse]
Lipstick on a letter that I never wrote
Someone else's perfume on my winter coat
They say this city never sleeps alone
Then who keeps calling, calling on my phone

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't you tell me it's over, don't you lie to my face
I can feel you in the shadows, I can see you in this place

[Chorus]
This is it, this is it
Every secret's coming out
This is it, this is it
No more shadows, no more doubt

[Bridge]
I gave you all my midnights
You gave me all your lies
Now the curtain's falling
And I see it in your eyes

[Chorus]
This is it, this is it
Every secret's coming out
This is it, this is it
No more shadows, no more doubt

[Outro]
This is it...
